title: When Prompting Fails to Sway: Inertia in Moral and Value Judgments of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates the moral and ethical alignment of LLMs using established psychological benchmarks: the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ-30) and the Revised Portrait Values Questionnaire (PVQ-RR). These tools specifically measure ethical dimensions such as care, fairness, loyalty, authority, and purity. Additionally, the study's persona-based framework explicitly incorporates religious denominations as demographic factors to probe model value judgments.
